457: func (store QAStore) Publish(publication QAPublication, token QAWriterToken) (resultErr error) {
458: 	if err := store.checkWriter(token); err != nil {
459: 		return err
460: 	}
461: 	if publication.Evidence != nil {
462: 		publication.State.SchemaVersion = QAStateSchemaVersion
463: 	}
464: 	if err := ValidateQAState(publication.State); err != nil {
465: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "publish", err.Error(), err)
466: 	}
467: 	if publication.State.Project != store.sprint.Project || publication.State.Sprint != store.sprint.Slug {
468: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "publish", "QA state scope does not match the selected sprint", nil)
469: 	}
470: 	statePath, err := store.StatePath()
471: 	if err != nil {
472: 		return err
473: 	}
474: 	reportPath, err := store.resolve(QAReportRelPath(store.sprint))
475: 	if err != nil {
476: 		return err
477: 	}
478: 	flowPath, err := FlowStatePath(store.root, store.sprint)
479: 	if err != nil {
480: 		return err
481: 	}
482: 	snapshots, err := captureQACanonicalFiles(statePath, reportPath, flowPath)
483: 	if err != nil {
484: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorPersistenceFailure, "publish", "cannot snapshot canonical QA files", err)
485: 	}
486: 	canonicalStarted := false
487: 	defer func() {
488: 		if resultErr != nil && canonicalStarted {
489: 			if rollbackErr := restoreQACanonicalFiles(snapshots); rollbackErr != nil {
490: 				resultErr = errors.Join(resultErr, NewQAError(QAErrorPersistenceFailure, "publish rollback", "cannot restore prior canonical QA files", rollbackErr))
491: 			}
492: 		}
493: 	}()
494: 	if publication.Map != nil {
495: 		if err := ValidateQAMap(*publication.Map); err != nil {
496: 			return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "publish map", err.Error(), err)
497: 		}
498: 		path, err := store.mapPath(publication.Map.SemanticAttemptID)
499: 		if err != nil {
500: 			return err
501: 		}
502: 		if err := store.checkWriter(token); err != nil {
503: 			return err
504: 		}
505: 		digest, err := store.writeRecord("map", path, publication.Map, true)
506: 		if err != nil {
507: 			return err
508: 		}
509: 		publication.State.Map = &QAArtifactRef{Path: QAMapRelPath(store.sprint, publication.Map.SemanticAttemptID), Digest: digest}
510: 		publication.State.CurrentAttemptID = publication.Map.SemanticAttemptID
511: 	}
512: 	sort.Slice(publication.Shards, func(i, j int) bool { return publication.Shards[i].ID < publication.Shards[j].ID })
513: 	for i := range publication.Shards {
514: 		shard := &publication.Shards[i]
515: 		if err := ValidateQAShard(*shard); err != nil {
516: 			return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "publish shard", err.Error(), err)
517: 		}
518: 		path, err := store.shardPath(shard.AttemptID, shard.ID)
519: 		if err != nil {
520: 			return err
521: 		}
522: 		if err := store.checkWriter(token); err != nil {
523: 			return err
524: 		}
525: 		if _, err := store.writeRecord("shard", path, shard, false); err != nil {
526: 			return err
527: 		}
528: 	}
529: 	if publication.Synthesis != nil {
530: 		if err := ValidateQASynthesis(*publication.Synthesis, MaximumQABudgets()); err != nil {
531: 			return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "publish synthesis", err.Error(), err)
532: 		}
533: 		path, err := store.synthesisPath(publication.Synthesis.AttemptID)
534: 		if err != nil {
535: 			return err
536: 		}
537: 		if err := store.checkWriter(token); err != nil {
538: 			return err
539: 		}
540: 		digest, err := store.writeRecord("synthesis", path, publication.Synthesis, false)
541: 		if err != nil {
542: 			return err
543: 		}
544: 		publication.State.Synthesis = &QAArtifactRef{Path: QASynthesisRelPath(store.sprint, publication.Synthesis.AttemptID), Digest: digest}
545: 	}
546: 	if publication.Evidence != nil {
547: 		canonicalStarted = len(publication.Evidence.Report) > 0
548: 		if err := store.publishEvidence(publication.Evidence, &publication.State, token); err != nil {
549: 			return err
550: 		}
551: 	}
552: 	if err := ValidateQAState(publication.State); err != nil {
553: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "publish", err.Error(), err)
554: 	}
555: 	canonicalStarted = true
556: 	if err := store.checkWriter(token); err != nil {
557: 		return err
558: 	}
559: 	stateDigest, err := store.writeRecord("state", statePath, &publication.State, false)
560: 	if err != nil {
561: 		return err
562: 	}
563: 	publication.Flow.QA = qaFlowSummary(publication.State, stateDigest, store.sprint)
564: 	if store.hooks.BeforeStep != nil {
565: 		if err := store.hooks.BeforeStep("flow", flowPath); err != nil {
566: 			return NewQAError(QAErrorPersistenceFailure, "publish flow summary", "flow summary publication was interrupted", err)
567: 		}
568: 	}
569: 	if err := store.checkWriter(token); err != nil {
570: 		return err
571: 	}
572: 	if err := SaveFlowState(store.root, store.sprint, publication.Flow); err != nil {
573: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorPersistenceFailure, "publish flow summary", "cannot publish QA flow summary", err)
574: 	}
575: 	return nil
576: }

578: // SaveRecoveredState is the explicit runtime-free recovery mutation. It can
579: // only record a non-active phase and never writes map, shard, or synthesis
580: // evidence. A previously validated completed state may be republished solely
581: // to reconcile its flow-summary pointer and digest.
582: func (store QAStore) SaveRecoveredState(state QAState, flow FlowState) error {
583: 	switch state.Phase {
584: 	case QAPhaseInterrupted, QAPhaseStale, QAPhaseInvalid, QAPhaseBlocked, QAPhaseCancelled, QAPhaseCompleted:
585: 	default:
586: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "recover", "recovery cannot publish active QA state", nil)
587: 	}
588: 	if err := ValidateQAState(state); err != nil {
589: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "recover", err.Error(), err)
590: 	}
591: 	path, err := store.StatePath()
592: 	if err != nil {
593: 		return err
594: 	}
595: 	digest, err := store.writeRecord("state", path, &state, false)
596: 	if err != nil {
597: 		return err
598: 	}
599: 	flow.QA = qaFlowSummary(state, digest, store.sprint)
600: 	if err := SaveFlowState(store.root, store.sprint, flow); err != nil {
601: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorPersistenceFailure, "recover", "cannot publish recovered flow summary", err)
602: 	}
603: 	return nil
604: }

211: func (store QAStore) resolve(rel string) (string, error) {
212: 	full, err := resolveSprintContained(store.root, store.sprint, rel)
213: 	if err != nil {
214: 		return "", NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "resolve path", "QA path escapes the selected sprint", err)
215: 	}
216: 	sprintRoot, err := resolveSprintContained(store.root, store.sprint, filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join("projects", store.sprint.Project, "sprints", store.sprint.Slug)))
217: 	if err != nil {
218: 		return "", err
219: 	}
220: 	relToSprint, err := filepath.Rel(sprintRoot, full)
221: 	if err != nil || relToSprint == "." || strings.HasPrefix(relToSprint, "..") {
222: 		return "", NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "resolve path", "QA path is outside the selected sprint", err)
223: 	}
224: 	current := sprintRoot
225: 	for _, part := range strings.Split(filepath.Clean(relToSprint), string(filepath.Separator)) {
226: 		current = filepath.Join(current, part)
227: 		info, statErr := os.Lstat(current)
228: 		if errors.Is(statErr, fs.ErrNotExist) {
229: 			continue
230: 		}
231: 		if statErr != nil {
232: 			return "", NewQAError(QAErrorPersistenceFailure, "inspect path", "cannot inspect QA path", statErr)
233: 		}
234: 		if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
235: 			return "", NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "resolve path", "QA path contains a symbolic link", nil)
236: 		}
237: 	}
238: 	return full, nil
239: }

379: func (store QAStore) readStrictVersion(path, kind string, expectedVersion int, value any) error {
380: 	info, err := os.Lstat(path)
381: 	if err != nil {
382: 		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
383: 			return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "load "+kind, kind+" is missing", err)
384: 		}
385: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorPersistenceFailure, "load "+kind, "cannot inspect QA file", err)
386: 	}
387: 	if !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Mode().Perm() != 0o600 {
388: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "load "+kind, "QA file must be a regular private 0600 file", nil)
389: 	}
390: 	file, err := os.Open(path)
391: 	if err != nil {
392: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorPersistenceFailure, "load "+kind, "cannot open QA file", err)
393: 	}
394: 	defer file.Close()
395: 	data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, qaHardStateBytes+1))
396: 	if err != nil {
397: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorPersistenceFailure, "load "+kind, "cannot read QA file", err)
398: 	}
399: 	if len(data) > qaHardStateBytes {
400: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorBudgetExhausted, "load "+kind, "QA file exceeds the hard state limit", nil)
401: 	}
402: 	var header struct {
403: 		SchemaVersion int `json:"schema_version"`
404: 	}
405: 	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &header); err != nil {
406: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "load "+kind, "malformed QA JSON", err)
407: 	}
408: 	versionAccepted := header.SchemaVersion == expectedVersion
409: 	if kind == "state" && expectedVersion == 0 {
410: 		versionAccepted = header.SchemaVersion == QASchemaVersion || header.SchemaVersion == QAStateSchemaVersion
411: 	}
412: 	if !versionAccepted {
413: 		category := QAErrorUnknownSchema
414: 		if header.SchemaVersion == 0 {
415: 			category = QAErrorInvalidState
416: 		}
417: 		return NewQAError(category, "load "+kind, fmt.Sprintf("unsupported QA schema version %d", header.SchemaVersion), nil)
418: 	}
419: 	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
420: 	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
421: 	if err := decoder.Decode(value); err != nil {
422: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "load "+kind, "malformed or unknown QA field", err)
423: 	}
424: 	var trailing any
425: 	if err := decoder.Decode(&trailing); err == nil {
426: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "load "+kind, "multiple JSON values", nil)
427: 	} else if !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
428: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "load "+kind, "trailing QA JSON", err)
429: 	}
430: 	return nil
431: }

457: func (store QAStore) Publish(publication QAPublication, token QAWriterToken) (resultErr error) {
458: 	if err := store.checkWriter(token); err != nil {
459: 		return err
460: 	}
461: 	if publication.Evidence != nil {
462: 		publication.State.SchemaVersion = QAStateSchemaVersion
463: 	}
464: 	if err := ValidateQAState(publication.State); err != nil {
465: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "publish", err.Error(), err)
466: 	}
467: 	if publication.State.Project != store.sprint.Project || publication.State.Sprint != store.sprint.Slug {
468: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "publish", "QA state scope does not match the selected sprint", nil)
469: 	}
470: 	statePath, err := store.StatePath()
471: 	if err != nil {
472: 		return err
473: 	}
474: 	reportPath, err := store.resolve(QAReportRelPath(store.sprint))
475: 	if err != nil {
476: 		return err
477: 	}
478: 	flowPath, err := FlowStatePath(store.root, store.sprint)
479: 	if err != nil {
480: 		return err
481: 	}
482: 	snapshots, err := captureQACanonicalFiles(statePath, reportPath, flowPath)
483: 	if err != nil {
484: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorPersistenceFailure, "publish", "cannot snapshot canonical QA files", err)
485: 	}
486: 	canonicalStarted := false
487: 	defer func() {
488: 		if resultErr != nil && canonicalStarted {
489: 			if rollbackErr := restoreQACanonicalFiles(snapshots); rollbackErr != nil {
490: 				resultErr = errors.Join(resultErr, NewQAError(QAErrorPersistenceFailure, "publish rollback", "cannot restore prior canonical QA files", rollbackErr))
491: 			}
492: 		}
493: 	}()
494: 	if publication.Map != nil {
495: 		if err := ValidateQAMap(*publication.Map); err != nil {
496: 			return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "publish map", err.Error(), err)
497: 		}
498: 		path, err := store.mapPath(publication.Map.SemanticAttemptID)
499: 		if err != nil {
500: 			return err
501: 		}
502: 		if err := store.checkWriter(token); err != nil {
503: 			return err
504: 		}
505: 		digest, err := store.writeRecord("map", path, publication.Map, true)
506: 		if err != nil {
507: 			return err
508: 		}
509: 		publication.State.Map = &QAArtifactRef{Path: QAMapRelPath(store.sprint, publication.Map.SemanticAttemptID), Digest: digest}
510: 		publication.State.CurrentAttemptID = publication.Map.SemanticAttemptID
511: 	}
512: 	sort.Slice(publication.Shards, func(i, j int) bool { return publication.Shards[i].ID < publication.Shards[j].ID })
513: 	for i := range publication.Shards {
514: 		shard := &publication.Shards[i]
515: 		if err := ValidateQAShard(*shard); err != nil {
516: 			return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "publish shard", err.Error(), err)
517: 		}
518: 		path, err := store.shardPath(shard.AttemptID, shard.ID)
519: 		if err != nil {
520: 			return err
521: 		}
522: 		if err := store.checkWriter(token); err != nil {
523: 			return err
524: 		}
525: 		if _, err := store.writeRecord("shard", path, shard, false); err != nil {
526: 			return err
527: 		}
528: 	}
529: 	if publication.Synthesis != nil {
530: 		if err := ValidateQASynthesis(*publication.Synthesis, MaximumQABudgets()); err != nil {
531: 			return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "publish synthesis", err.Error(), err)
532: 		}
533: 		path, err := store.synthesisPath(publication.Synthesis.AttemptID)
534: 		if err != nil {
535: 			return err
536: 		}
537: 		if err := store.checkWriter(token); err != nil {
538: 			return err
539: 		}
540: 		digest, err := store.writeRecord("synthesis", path, publication.Synthesis, false)
541: 		if err != nil {
542: 			return err
543: 		}
544: 		publication.State.Synthesis = &QAArtifactRef{Path: QASynthesisRelPath(store.sprint, publication.Synthesis.AttemptID), Digest: digest}
545: 	}
546: 	if publication.Evidence != nil {
547: 		canonicalStarted = len(publication.Evidence.Report) > 0
548: 		if err := store.publishEvidence(publication.Evidence, &publication.State, token); err != nil {
549: 			return err
550: 		}
551: 	}
552: 	if err := ValidateQAState(publication.State); err != nil {
553: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "publish", err.Error(), err)
554: 	}
555: 	canonicalStarted = true
556: 	if err := store.checkWriter(token); err != nil {
557: 		return err
558: 	}
559: 	stateDigest, err := store.writeRecord("state", statePath, &publication.State, false)
560: 	if err != nil {
561: 		return err
562: 	}
563: 	publication.Flow.QA = qaFlowSummary(publication.State, stateDigest, store.sprint)
564: 	if store.hooks.BeforeStep != nil {
565: 		if err := store.hooks.BeforeStep("flow", flowPath); err != nil {
566: 			return NewQAError(QAErrorPersistenceFailure, "publish flow summary", "flow summary publication was interrupted", err)
567: 		}
568: 	}
569: 	if err := store.checkWriter(token); err != nil {
570: 		return err
571: 	}
572: 	if err := SaveFlowState(store.root, store.sprint, publication.Flow); err != nil {
573: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorPersistenceFailure, "publish flow summary", "cannot publish QA flow summary", err)
574: 	}
575: 	return nil
576: }

578: // SaveRecoveredState is the explicit runtime-free recovery mutation. It can
579: // only record a non-active phase and never writes map, shard, or synthesis
580: // evidence. A previously validated completed state may be republished solely
581: // to reconcile its flow-summary pointer and digest.
582: func (store QAStore) SaveRecoveredState(state QAState, flow FlowState) error {
583: 	switch state.Phase {
584: 	case QAPhaseInterrupted, QAPhaseStale, QAPhaseInvalid, QAPhaseBlocked, QAPhaseCancelled, QAPhaseCompleted:
585: 	default:
586: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "recover", "recovery cannot publish active QA state", nil)
587: 	}
588: 	if err := ValidateQAState(state); err != nil {
589: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "recover", err.Error(), err)
590: 	}
591: 	path, err := store.StatePath()
592: 	if err != nil {
593: 		return err
594: 	}
595: 	digest, err := store.writeRecord("state", path, &state, false)
596: 	if err != nil {
597: 		return err
598: 	}
599: 	flow.QA = qaFlowSummary(state, digest, store.sprint)
600: 	if err := SaveFlowState(store.root, store.sprint, flow); err != nil {
601: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorPersistenceFailure, "recover", "cannot publish recovered flow summary", err)
602: 	}
603: 	return nil
604: }

606: func (store QAStore) checkWriter(token QAWriterToken) error {
607: 	if err := token.Validate(); err != nil {
608: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorConflict, "publish", err.Error(), err)
609: 	}
610: 	if store.fence == nil {
611: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorConflict, "publish", "no QA writer fence is configured", nil)
612: 	}
613: 	if err := store.fence(token); err != nil {
614: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorConflict, "publish", "QA writer token is stale", err)
615: 	}
616: 	return nil
617: }

619: func (store QAStore) writeRecord(kind, path string, value any, immutable bool) (string, error) {
620: 	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(value, "", "  ")
621: 	if err != nil {
622: 		return "", NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "publish "+kind, "cannot encode QA record", err)
623: 	}
624: 	data = append(data, '\n')

func newQAID(kind, project, sprint, parent string, content any) (string, error) {
	if !safeQAName(project) || !safeQAName(sprint) || strings.TrimSpace(kind) == "" {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("invalid QA identity scope")
	}
	data, err := canonicalQAJSON(content)
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize QA identity: %w", err)
	}
	digest := sha256.Sum256(bytes.Join([][]byte{[]byte(QAIDScope), []byte(kind), []byte(project), []byte(sprint), []byte(parent), data}, []byte{0}))
	return fmt.Sprintf("%s-%s-%s", QAIDScope, kind, hex.EncodeToString(digest[:12])), nil
}

func canonicalQAJSON(value any) ([]byte, error) {
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	encoder := json.NewEncoder(&buf)
	encoder.SetEscapeHTML(false)
	if err := encoder.Encode(value); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return bytes.TrimSuffix(buf.Bytes(), []byte("\n")), nil
}

var qaIDPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^qa-v1-(attempt|map|shard|theory|challenge|synthesis)-[0-9a-f]{24}$`)

func validQAID(value string) bool { return qaIDPattern.MatchString(value) }

func safeQAName(value string) bool {
	if value == "" || len(value) > 128 || strings.Contains(value, "..") {
		return false
	}
	for _, r := range value {
		if !(r == '-' || r == '_' || r == '.' || r >= 'a' && r <= 'z' || r >= 'A' && r <= 'Z' || r >= '0' && r <= '9') {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func validFingerprint(value string) bool {
	if len(value) != sha256.Size*2 {
		return false
	}
	_, err := hex.DecodeString(value)
	return err == nil
}

func ValidateQASettings(settings QASettings) error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(settings.Runtime.Model) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("qa model is required")
	}
	if err := validateQABudgets(settings.Budgets); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	seen := map[string]struct{}{}
	for _, source := range settings.Sources {
		if strings.TrimSpace(source.Field) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(source.Source) == "" {
			return fmt.Errorf("QA effective source requires field and source")
		}
		if _, duplicate := seen[source.Field]; duplicate {
			return fmt.Errorf("duplicate QA effective source %q", source.Field)
		}
		seen[source.Field] = struct{}{}
	}
	return nil
}

func validateQABudgets(got QABudgets) error {
	max := MaximumQABudgets()
	ints := []struct {
		name     string
		got, max int
	}{
		{"changed_paths", got.ChangedPaths, max.ChangedPaths}, {"primary_shards", got.PrimaryShards, max.PrimaryShards}, {"boundary_shards", got.BoundaryShards, max.BoundaryShards},
		{"follow_up_shards", got.FollowUpShards, max.FollowUpShards}, {"total_shards", got.TotalShards, max.TotalShards}, {"pending_entries", got.PendingEntries, max.PendingEntries},
		{"changed_paths_per_shard", got.ChangedPathsPerShard, max.ChangedPathsPerShard}, {"context_paths_per_shard", got.ContextPathsPerShard, max.ContextPathsPerShard},
		{"context_expansions", got.ContextExpansions, max.ContextExpansions}, {"paths_per_expansion", got.PathsPerExpansion, max.PathsPerExpansion},
		{"behavioral_concerns_per_shard", got.BehavioralConcernsPerShard, max.BehavioralConcernsPerShard}, {"theories_per_shard", got.TheoriesPerShard, max.TheoriesPerShard},
		{"iterations_per_attempt", got.IterationsPerAttempt, max.IterationsPerAttempt}, {"commands_per_attempt", got.CommandsPerAttempt, max.CommandsPerAttempt},
		{"output_repair_attempts", got.OutputRepairAttempts, max.OutputRepairAttempts}, {"concurrent_investigators", got.ConcurrentInvestigators, max.ConcurrentInvestigators},
		{"command_output_bytes", got.CommandOutputBytes, max.CommandOutputBytes}, {"shard_output_bytes", got.ShardOutputBytes, max.ShardOutputBytes},
		{"prompt_bytes", got.PromptBytes, max.PromptBytes}, {"recent_progress", got.RecentProgress, max.RecentProgress},
		{"retained_attempts", got.RetainedAttempts, max.RetainedAttempts}, {"state_bytes", got.StateBytes, max.StateBytes},
		{"tree_files", got.TreeFiles, max.TreeFiles}, {"generated_checks", got.GeneratedChecks, max.GeneratedChecks},
		{"generated_patch_bytes", got.GeneratedPatchBytes, max.GeneratedPatchBytes}, {"evidence_records", got.EvidenceRecords, max.EvidenceRecords},
		{"issues", got.Issues, max.Issues}, {"analyzer_calls", got.AnalyzerCalls, max.AnalyzerCalls}, {"evaluator_calls", got.EvaluatorCalls, max.EvaluatorCalls},
	}
	for _, limit := range ints {
		if limit.got <= 0 || limit.got > limit.max {
			return fmt.Errorf("qa budget %s must be between 1 and %d", limit.name, limit.max)
		}
	}
	durations := []struct {
		name     string
		got, max time.Duration
	}{{"command_timeout", got.CommandTimeout, max.CommandTimeout}, {"shard_timeout", got.ShardTimeout, max.ShardTimeout}, {"run_timeout", got.RunTimeout, max.RunTimeout}, {"cleanup_timeout", got.CleanupTimeout, max.CleanupTimeout}}
	for _, limit := range durations {
		if limit.got <= 0 || limit.got > limit.max {
			return fmt.Errorf("qa budget %s must be positive and no greater than %s", limit.name, limit.max)
		}
	}
	for _, limit := range []struct {
		name     string
		got, max int64
	}{{"tree_bytes", got.TreeBytes, max.TreeBytes}, {"file_bytes", got.FileBytes, max.FileBytes}} {
		if limit.got <= 0 || limit.got > limit.max {
			return fmt.Errorf("qa budget %s must be between 1 and %d", limit.name, limit.max)
		}
	}
	if got.AnalyzerCalls != 3 || got.EvaluatorCalls != 3 {
		return fmt.Errorf("qa semantic analyzer and evaluator counts must be exactly 3")
	}
	return nil
}

func ValidateQATheory(theory QATheory) error {
	if theory.SchemaVersion != QASchemaVersion || !validQAID(theory.ID) || !validQAID(theory.ShardID) {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA theory schema or identity")
	}
	required := map[string]string{"claim": theory.Claim, "basis": theory.Basis, "verification_surface": theory.VerificationSurface, "severity_if_confirmed": theory.SeverityIfConfirmed, "confirmation_condition": theory.ConfirmationCondition, "refutation_condition": theory.RefutationCondition, "inconclusive_condition": theory.InconclusiveCondition, "safe_evidence_strategy": theory.SafeEvidenceStrategy, "outcome_reason": theory.OutcomeReason}
	for name, value := range required {
		if strings.TrimSpace(value) == "" {
			return fmt.Errorf("QA theory %s is required", name)
		}
	}
	if len(theory.ExpectationRefs) == 0 || len(theory.AttemptHistory) == 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("QA theory expectation references and attempt history are required")
	}
	if !validFingerprint(theory.ImplementationFingerprint) {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA theory implementation fingerprint")
	}
	if !containsQATheoryOutcome(theory.Outcome) {
		return fmt.Errorf("unsupported QA theory outcome %q", theory.Outcome)
	}
	return nil
}

func ValidateQAMap(m QAMap) error {
	if m.SchemaVersion != QASchemaVersion || !validQAID(m.ID) || !validQAID(m.SemanticAttemptID) || !safeQAName(m.Project) || !safeQAName(m.Sprint) {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA map schema or identity")
	}
	for name, value := range map[string]string{"governed input": m.GovernedInputFingerprint, "implementation": m.ImplementationFingerprint, "review": m.ReviewFingerprint, "policy": m.PolicyFingerprint, "check catalog": m.CheckCatalogFingerprint, "target": m.Target.Fingerprint} {
		if !validFingerprint(value) {
			return fmt.Errorf("invalid %s fingerprint", name)
		}
	}
	if err := validateQABudgets(m.Budgets); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	owners := map[string]int{}
	ownerIDs := map[string]string{}
	for _, shard := range m.Shards {
		if err := ValidateQAShard(shard); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if shard.Kind == QAShardPrimary {
			for _, path := range shard.ChangedPaths {
				owners[path]++
				ownerIDs[path] = shard.ID
			}
		}
	}
	for _, path := range m.Coverage.ChangedPaths {
		if owners[path] != 1 || m.Coverage.PrimaryOwners[path] != ownerIDs[path] {
			return fmt.Errorf("changed path %q must have exactly one primary owner", path)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func ValidateQAShard(shard QAShard) error {
	if shard.SchemaVersion != QASchemaVersion || !validQAID(shard.ID) || !validQAID(shard.AttemptID) || strings.TrimSpace(shard.Title) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA shard schema or identity")
	}
	switch shard.Kind {
	case QAShardPrimary:
		if len(shard.ChangedPaths) == 0 {
			return fmt.Errorf("primary QA shard requires changed paths")
		}
	case QAShardBoundary:
		if len(shard.OverlapPaths) == 0 || strings.TrimSpace(shard.BoundaryReason) == "" {
			return fmt.Errorf("boundary QA shard requires overlap paths and reason")
		}
	case QAShardFollowUp:
		if len(shard.ParentTheoryIDs) == 0 {
			return fmt.Errorf("follow-up QA shard requires parent theories")
		}
	default:
		return fmt.Errorf("unsupported QA shard kind %q", shard.Kind)
	}
	if !containsQAPhase(shard.Phase) || len(shard.BehavioralConcerns) == 0 || len(shard.ExpectationRefs) == 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("QA shard phase, concerns, and expectations are required")
	}
	return nil
}

func ValidateQAState(state QAState) error {
	if state.SchemaVersion != QASchemaVersion && state.SchemaVersion != QAStateSchemaVersion || !safeQAName(state.Project) || !safeQAName(state.Sprint) || !containsQAPhase(state.Phase) {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA state schema, scope, or phase")
	}
	if state.CurrentAttemptID != "" && !validQAID(state.CurrentAttemptID) {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid current QA attempt ID")
	}
	if state.CompletedShards < 0 || state.TotalShards < 0 || state.CompletedShards > state.TotalShards {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA shard counts")
	}
	if state.EvidenceCount < 0 || state.RejectedCount < 0 || state.IssueCount < 0 || state.RegressionCandidates < 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA evidence counts")
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(state.NextAction) == "" || state.UpdatedAt.IsZero() {
		return fmt.Errorf("QA next action and update time are required")
	}
	return nil
}

func ValidateQASynthesis(synthesis QASynthesis, budgets QABudgets) error {
	if synthesis.SchemaVersion != QASchemaVersion || !validQAID(synthesis.ID) || !validQAID(synthesis.AttemptID) || !validQAID(synthesis.MapID) {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA synthesis schema or identity")
	}
	theoryIDs := make(map[string]struct{}, len(synthesis.TheoryIDs))
	for _, theoryID := range synthesis.TheoryIDs {
		if !validQAID(theoryID) {
			return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA synthesis theory reference")
		}
		theoryIDs[theoryID] = struct{}{}
	}
	if len(synthesis.FollowUpShards) > budgets.FollowUpShards {
		return fmt.Errorf("QA synthesis exceeds follow-up shard budget")
	}
	if len(synthesis.Challenges) > budgets.FollowUpShards {
		return fmt.Errorf("QA synthesis exceeds challenger record budget")
	}
	for _, challenge := range synthesis.Challenges {
		if err := ValidateQAChallenge(challenge, budgets); err != nil || challenge.MapID != synthesis.MapID {
			return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA synthesis challenge")
		}
		for _, theoryID := range challenge.TheoryIDs {
			if _, ok := theoryIDs[theoryID]; !ok {
				return fmt.Errorf("QA synthesis challenge references an unknown theory")
			}
		}
	}
	for _, shard := range synthesis.FollowUpShards {
		if err := ValidateQAShard(shard); err != nil || shard.Kind != QAShardFollowUp {
			return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA synthesis follow-up shard")
		}
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(synthesis.NextAction) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("QA synthesis next action is required")
	}
	return nil
}

func ValidateQAChallenge(challenge QAChallenge, budgets QABudgets) error {
	if challenge.SchemaVersion != QASchemaVersion || !validQAID(challenge.ID) || !validQAID(challenge.MapID) {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA challenge schema or identity")
	}
	if len(challenge.TheoryIDs) == 0 || len(challenge.TheoryIDs) > budgets.TheoriesPerShard {
		return fmt.Errorf("QA challenge theory references exceed bounds")
	}
	for _, theoryID := range challenge.TheoryIDs {
		if !validQAID(theoryID) {
			return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA challenge theory reference")
		}
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(challenge.Claim) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(challenge.Basis) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(challenge.SafeEvidenceStrategy) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("QA challenge claim, basis, and safe evidence strategy are required")
	}
	return nil
}

func containsQAPhase(value QAPhaseStatus) bool {
	for _, allowed := range QAPhaseStatuses() {
		if value == allowed {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func containsQATheoryOutcome(value QATheoryOutcome) bool {
	for _, allowed := range QATheoryOutcomes() {
		if value == allowed {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func normalizeQAStrings(values []string) []string {
	out := make([]string, 0, len(values))
	seen := map[string]struct{}{}
	for _, value := range values {
		value = strings.ReplaceAll(strings.TrimSpace(value), "\r\n", "\n")
		if value == "" {
			continue
		}
		if _, ok := seen[value]; ok {
			continue
		}
		seen[value] = struct{}{}
		out = append(out, value)
	}
	sort.Strings(out)
	return out
}

type QAErrorCategory string

const (
	QAErrorUnknownSchema      QAErrorCategory = "unknown_schema"
	QAErrorInvalidState       QAErrorCategory = "invalid_state"
	QAErrorStaleInput         QAErrorCategory = "stale_input"
	QAErrorPermissionDenied   QAErrorCategory = "permission_denied"
	QAErrorBudgetExhausted    QAErrorCategory = "budget_exhausted"
	QAErrorConflict           QAErrorCategory = "conflict"
	QAErrorPersistenceFailure QAErrorCategory = "persistence_failure"
	QAErrorRuntimeUnavailable QAErrorCategory = "runtime_unavailable"
	QAErrorAdmissionBlocked   QAErrorCategory = "admission_blocked"
	QAErrorAssertionFailure   QAErrorCategory = "assertion_failure"
	QAErrorCleanupUncertain   QAErrorCategory = "cleanup_uncertain"
	QAErrorMalformedEvidence  QAErrorCategory = "malformed_evidence"
)

type QAError struct {
	Category  QAErrorCategory `json:"category"`
	Operation string          `json:"operation"`
	Detail    string          `json:"detail"`
	Recovery  string          `json:"recovery"`
	Cause     error           `json:"-"`
}

func (e *QAError) Error() string {
	if e == nil {
		return ""
	}
	if e.Detail != "" {
		return fmt.Sprintf("qa %s: %s", e.Operation, e.Detail)
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf("qa %s: %s", e.Operation, e.Category)
}

func (e *QAError) Unwrap() error {
	if e == nil {
		return nil
	}
	return e.Cause
}

func NewQAError(category QAErrorCategory, operation, detail string, cause error) *QAError {
	return &QAError{Category: category, Operation: operation, Detail: detail, Recovery: qaRecovery(category), Cause: cause}
}

func AsQAError(err error) (*QAError, bool) {
	var target *QAError
	ok := errors.As(err, &target)
	return target, ok
}

func qaRecovery(category QAErrorCategory) string {
	switch category {
	case QAErrorUnknownSchema:
		return "Use a compatible UltraPlan binary or an explicit supported migration."
	case QAErrorInvalidState:
		return "Inspect the detailed state and run explicit QA recovery."
	case QAErrorStaleInput:
		return "Rebuild the QA map from current governed inputs."
	case QAErrorPermissionDenied:
		return "Use a runtime that enforces the required read-only permission policy."
	case QAErrorBudgetExhausted:
		return "Reduce the governed scope or lower work per attempt; do not raise product maxima."
	case QAErrorConflict:
		return "Wait for the current owner or cancel it through run control."
	case QAErrorPersistenceFailure:
		return "Restore reliable workspace persistence, then run explicit QA recovery."
	case QAErrorRuntimeUnavailable:
		return "Restore the configured runtime and resume the current semantic attempt."
	case QAErrorAdmissionBlocked:
		return "Restore the current review, containing smoke, mapping, and isolation prerequisites before retrying."
	case QAErrorAssertionFailure:
		return "Inspect the admitted evidence and adjudicated issue before any governed repair."
	case QAErrorCleanupUncertain:
		return "Inspect and remove the isolated workspace, then start a new QA attempt."
	case QAErrorMalformedEvidence:
		return "Discard the invalid attempt and rerun the evidence plan from current inputs."
	default:
		return "Inspect the QA status and next action."
	}
}

542: func newQAID(kind, project, sprint, parent string, content any) (string, error) {
543: 	if !safeQAName(project) || !safeQAName(sprint) || strings.TrimSpace(kind) == "" {
544: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("invalid QA identity scope")
545: 	}
546: 	data, err := canonicalQAJSON(content)
547: 	if err != nil {
548: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize QA identity: %w", err)
549: 	}
550: 	digest := sha256.Sum256(bytes.Join([][]byte{[]byte(QAIDScope), []byte(kind), []byte(project), []byte(sprint), []byte(parent), data}, []byte{0}))
551: 	return fmt.Sprintf("%s-%s-%s", QAIDScope, kind, hex.EncodeToString(digest[:12])), nil
552: }
553: 
554: func canonicalQAJSON(value any) ([]byte, error) {
555: 	var buf bytes.Buffer
556: 	encoder := json.NewEncoder(&buf)
557: 	encoder.SetEscapeHTML(false)
558: 	if err := encoder.Encode(value); err != nil {
559: 		return nil, err
560: 	}
561: 	return bytes.TrimSuffix(buf.Bytes(), []byte("\n")), nil
562: }

564: var qaIDPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^qa-v1-(attempt|map|shard|theory|challenge|synthesis)-[0-9a-f]{24}$`)
565: 
566: func validQAID(value string) bool { return qaIDPattern.MatchString(value) }
567: 
568: func safeQAName(value string) bool {
569: 	if value == "" || len(value) > 128 || strings.Contains(value, "..") {
570: 		return false
571: 	}
572: 	for _, r := range value {
573: 		if !(r == '-' || r == '_' || r == '.' || r >= 'a' && r <= 'z' || r >= 'A' && r <= 'Z' || r >= '0' && r <= '9') {
574: 			return false
575: 		}
576: 	}
577: 	return true
578: }
579: 
580: func validFingerprint(value string) bool {
581: 	if len(value) != sha256.Size*2 {
582: 		return false
583: 	}
584: 	_, err := hex.DecodeString(value)
585: 	return err == nil
586: }

588: func ValidateQASettings(settings QASettings) error {
589: 	if strings.TrimSpace(settings.Runtime.Model) == "" {
590: 		return fmt.Errorf("qa model is required")
591: 	}
592: 	if err := validateQABudgets(settings.Budgets); err != nil {
593: 		return err
594: 	}
595: 	seen := map[string]struct{}{}
596: 	for _, source := range settings.Sources {
597: 		if strings.TrimSpace(source.Field) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(source.Source) == "" {
598: 			return fmt.Errorf("QA effective source requires field and source")
599: 		}
600: 		if _, duplicate := seen[source.Field]; duplicate {
601: 			return fmt.Errorf("duplicate QA effective source %q", source.Field)
602: 		}
603: 		seen[source.Field] = struct{}{}
604: 	}
605: 	return nil
606: }

608: func validateQABudgets(got QABudgets) error {
609: 	max := MaximumQABudgets()
610: 	ints := []struct {
611: 		name     string
612: 		got, max int
613: 	}{
614: 		{"changed_paths", got.ChangedPaths, max.ChangedPaths}, {"primary_shards", got.PrimaryShards, max.PrimaryShards}, {"boundary_shards", got.BoundaryShards, max.BoundaryShards},
615: 		{"follow_up_shards", got.FollowUpShards, max.FollowUpShards}, {"total_shards", got.TotalShards, max.TotalShards}, {"pending_entries", got.PendingEntries, max.PendingEntries},
616: 		{"changed_paths_per_shard", got.ChangedPathsPerShard, max.ChangedPathsPerShard}, {"context_paths_per_shard", got.ContextPathsPerShard, max.ContextPathsPerShard},
617: 		{"context_expansions", got.ContextExpansions, max.ContextExpansions}, {"paths_per_expansion", got.PathsPerExpansion, max.PathsPerExpansion},
618: 		{"behavioral_concerns_per_shard", got.BehavioralConcernsPerShard, max.BehavioralConcernsPerShard}, {"theories_per_shard", got.TheoriesPerShard, max.TheoriesPerShard},
619: 		{"iterations_per_attempt", got.IterationsPerAttempt, max.IterationsPerAttempt}, {"commands_per_attempt", got.CommandsPerAttempt, max.CommandsPerAttempt},
620: 		{"output_repair_attempts", got.OutputRepairAttempts, max.OutputRepairAttempts}, {"concurrent_investigators", got.ConcurrentInvestigators, max.ConcurrentInvestigators},
621: 		{"command_output_bytes", got.CommandOutputBytes, max.CommandOutputBytes}, {"shard_output_bytes", got.ShardOutputBytes, max.ShardOutputBytes},
622: 		{"prompt_bytes", got.PromptBytes, max.PromptBytes}, {"recent_progress", got.RecentProgress, max.RecentProgress},
623: 		{"retained_attempts", got.RetainedAttempts, max.RetainedAttempts}, {"state_bytes", got.StateBytes, max.StateBytes},
624: 		{"tree_files", got.TreeFiles, max.TreeFiles}, {"generated_checks", got.GeneratedChecks, max.GeneratedChecks},
625: 		{"generated_patch_bytes", got.GeneratedPatchBytes, max.GeneratedPatchBytes}, {"evidence_records", got.EvidenceRecords, max.EvidenceRecords},
626: 		{"issues", got.Issues, max.Issues}, {"analyzer_calls", got.AnalyzerCalls, max.AnalyzerCalls}, {"evaluator_calls", got.EvaluatorCalls, max.EvaluatorCalls},
627: 	}
628: 	for _, limit := range ints {
629: 		if limit.got <= 0 || limit.got > limit.max {
630: 			return fmt.Errorf("qa budget %s must be between 1 and %d", limit.name, limit.max)
631: 		}
632: 	}
633: 	durations := []struct {
634: 		name     string
635: 		got, max time.Duration
636: 	}{{"command_timeout", got.CommandTimeout, max.CommandTimeout}, {"shard_timeout", got.ShardTimeout, max.ShardTimeout}, {"run_timeout", got.RunTimeout, max.RunTimeout}, {"cleanup_timeout", got.CleanupTimeout, max.CleanupTimeout}}
637: 	for _, limit := range durations {
638: 		if limit.got <= 0 || limit.got > limit.max {
639: 			return fmt.Errorf("qa budget %s must be positive and no greater than %s", limit.name, limit.max)
640: 		}
641: 	}
642: 	for _, limit := range []struct {
643: 		name     string
644: 		got, max int64
645: 	}{{"tree_bytes", got.TreeBytes, max.TreeBytes}, {"file_bytes", got.FileBytes, max.FileBytes}} {
646: 		if limit.got <= 0 || limit.got > limit.max {
647: 			return fmt.Errorf("qa budget %s must be between 1 and %d", limit.name, limit.max)
648: 		}
649: 	}
650: 	if got.AnalyzerCalls != 3 || got.EvaluatorCalls != 3 {
651: 		return fmt.Errorf("qa semantic analyzer and evaluator counts must be exactly 3")
652: 	}
653: 	return nil
654: }

656: func ValidateQATheory(theory QATheory) error {
657: 	if theory.SchemaVersion != QASchemaVersion || !validQAID(theory.ID) || !validQAID(theory.ShardID) {
658: 		return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA theory schema or identity")
659: 	}
660: 	required := map[string]string{"claim": theory.Claim, "basis": theory.Basis, "verification_surface": theory.VerificationSurface, "severity_if_confirmed": theory.SeverityIfConfirmed, "confirmation_condition": theory.ConfirmationCondition, "refutation_condition": theory.RefutationCondition, "inconclusive_condition": theory.InconclusiveCondition, "safe_evidence_strategy": theory.SafeEvidenceStrategy, "outcome_reason": theory.OutcomeReason}
661: 	for name, value := range required {
662: 		if strings.TrimSpace(value) == "" {
663: 			return fmt.Errorf("QA theory %s is required", name)
664: 		}
665: 	}
666: 	if len(theory.ExpectationRefs) == 0 || len(theory.AttemptHistory) == 0 {
667: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA theory expectation references and attempt history are required")
668: 	}
669: 	if !validFingerprint(theory.ImplementationFingerprint) {
670: 		return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA theory implementation fingerprint")
671: 	}
672: 	if !containsQATheoryOutcome(theory.Outcome) {
673: 		return fmt.Errorf("unsupported QA theory outcome %q", theory.Outcome)
674: 	}
675: 	return nil
676: }

678: func ValidateQAMap(m QAMap) error {
679: 	if m.SchemaVersion != QASchemaVersion || !validQAID(m.ID) || !validQAID(m.SemanticAttemptID) || !safeQAName(m.Project) || !safeQAName(m.Sprint) {
680: 		return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA map schema or identity")
681: 	}
682: 	for name, value := range map[string]string{"governed input": m.GovernedInputFingerprint, "implementation": m.ImplementationFingerprint, "review": m.ReviewFingerprint, "policy": m.PolicyFingerprint, "check catalog": m.CheckCatalogFingerprint, "target": m.Target.Fingerprint} {
683: 		if !validFingerprint(value) {
684: 			return fmt.Errorf("invalid %s fingerprint", name)
685: 		}
686: 	}
687: 	if err := validateQABudgets(m.Budgets); err != nil {
688: 		return err
689: 	}
690: 	owners := map[string]int{}
691: 	ownerIDs := map[string]string{}
692: 	for _, shard := range m.Shards {
693: 		if err := ValidateQAShard(shard); err != nil {
694: 			return err
695: 		}
696: 		if shard.Kind == QAShardPrimary {
697: 			for _, path := range shard.ChangedPaths {
698: 				owners[path]++
699: 				ownerIDs[path] = shard.ID
700: 			}
701: 		}
702: 	}
703: 	for _, path := range m.Coverage.ChangedPaths {
704: 		if owners[path] != 1 || m.Coverage.PrimaryOwners[path] != ownerIDs[path] {
705: 			return fmt.Errorf("changed path %q must have exactly one primary owner", path)
706: 		}
707: 	}
708: 	return nil
709: }

711: func ValidateQAShard(shard QAShard) error {
712: 	if shard.SchemaVersion != QASchemaVersion || !validQAID(shard.ID) || !validQAID(shard.AttemptID) || strings.TrimSpace(shard.Title) == "" {
713: 		return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA shard schema or identity")
714: 	}
715: 	switch shard.Kind {
716: 	case QAShardPrimary:
717: 		if len(shard.ChangedPaths) == 0 {
718: 			return fmt.Errorf("primary QA shard requires changed paths")
719: 		}
720: 	case QAShardBoundary:
721: 		if len(shard.OverlapPaths) == 0 || strings.TrimSpace(shard.BoundaryReason) == "" {
722: 			return fmt.Errorf("boundary QA shard requires overlap paths and reason")
723: 		}
724: 	case QAShardFollowUp:
725: 		if len(shard.ParentTheoryIDs) == 0 {
726: 			return fmt.Errorf("follow-up QA shard requires parent theories")
727: 		}
728: 	default:
729: 		return fmt.Errorf("unsupported QA shard kind %q", shard.Kind)
730: 	}
731: 	if !containsQAPhase(shard.Phase) || len(shard.BehavioralConcerns) == 0 || len(shard.ExpectationRefs) == 0 {
732: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA shard phase, concerns, and expectations are required")
733: 	}
734: 	return nil
735: }

737: func ValidateQAState(state QAState) error {
738: 	if state.SchemaVersion != QASchemaVersion && state.SchemaVersion != QAStateSchemaVersion || !safeQAName(state.Project) || !safeQAName(state.Sprint) || !containsQAPhase(state.Phase) {
739: 		return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA state schema, scope, or phase")
740: 	}
741: 	if state.CurrentAttemptID != "" && !validQAID(state.CurrentAttemptID) {
742: 		return fmt.Errorf("invalid current QA attempt ID")
743: 	}
744: 	if state.CompletedShards < 0 || state.TotalShards < 0 || state.CompletedShards > state.TotalShards {
745: 		return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA shard counts")
746: 	}
747: 	if state.EvidenceCount < 0 || state.RejectedCount < 0 || state.IssueCount < 0 || state.RegressionCandidates < 0 {
748: 		return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA evidence counts")
749: 	}
750: 	if strings.TrimSpace(state.NextAction) == "" || state.UpdatedAt.IsZero() {
751: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA next action and update time are required")
752: 	}
753: 	return nil
754: }

756: func ValidateQASynthesis(synthesis QASynthesis, budgets QABudgets) error {
757: 	if synthesis.SchemaVersion != QASchemaVersion || !validQAID(synthesis.ID) || !validQAID(synthesis.AttemptID) || !validQAID(synthesis.MapID) {
758: 		return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA synthesis schema or identity")
759: 	}
760: 	theoryIDs := make(map[string]struct{}, len(synthesis.TheoryIDs))
761: 	for _, theoryID := range synthesis.TheoryIDs {

763: 			return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA synthesis theory reference")

542: func newQAID(kind, project, sprint, parent string, content any) (string, error) {
543: 	if !safeQAName(project) || !safeQAName(sprint) || strings.TrimSpace(kind) == "" {
544: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("invalid QA identity scope")
545: 	}
546: 	data, err := canonicalQAJSON(content)
547: 	if err != nil {
548: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize QA identity: %w", err)
549: 	}
550: 	digest := sha256.Sum256(bytes.Join([][]byte{[]byte(QAIDScope), []byte(kind), []byte(project), []byte(sprint), []byte(parent), data}, []byte{0}))
551: 	return fmt.Sprintf("%s-%s-%s", QAIDScope, kind, hex.EncodeToString(digest[:12])), nil
552: }
553: 
554: func canonicalQAJSON(value any) ([]byte, error) {
555: 	var buf bytes.Buffer
556: 	encoder := json.NewEncoder(&buf)
557: 	encoder.SetEscapeHTML(false)
558: 	if err := encoder.Encode(value); err != nil {
559: 		return nil, err
560: 	}
561: 	return bytes.TrimSuffix(buf.Bytes(), []byte("\n")), nil
562: }

564: var qaIDPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^qa-v1-(attempt|map|shard|theory|challenge|synthesis)-[0-9a-f]{24}$`)
565: 
566: func validQAID(value string) bool { return qaIDPattern.MatchString(value) }

568: func safeQAName(value string) bool {
569: 	if value == "" || len(value) > 128 || strings.Contains(value, "..") {
570: 		return false
571: 	}
572: 	for _, r := range value {
573: 		if !(r == '-' || r == '_' || r == '.' || r >= 'a' && r <= 'z' || r >= 'A' && r <= 'Z' || r >= '0' && r <= '9') {
574: 			return false
575: 		}
576: 	}
577: 	return true
578: }

580: func validFingerprint(value string) bool {
581: 	if len(value) != sha256.Size*2 {
582: 		return false
583: 	}
584: 	_, err := hex.DecodeString(value)
585: 	return err == nil
586: }

608: func validateQABudgets(got QABudgets) error {
609: 	max := MaximumQABudgets()
610: 	ints := []struct {
611: 		name     string
612: 		got, max int
613: 	}{
614: 		{"changed_paths", got.ChangedPaths, max.ChangedPaths}, {"primary_shards", got.PrimaryShards, max.PrimaryShards}, {"boundary_shards", got.BoundaryShards, max.BoundaryShards},
615: 		{"follow_up_shards", got.FollowUpShards, max.FollowUpShards}, {"total_shards", got.TotalShards, max.TotalShards}, {"pending_entries", got.PendingEntries, max.PendingEntries},
616: 		{"changed_paths_per_shard", got.ChangedPathsPerShard, max.ChangedPathsPerShard}, {"context_paths_per_shard", got.ContextPathsPerShard, max.ContextPathsPerShard},
617: 		{"context_expansions", got.ContextExpansions, max.ContextExpansions}, {"paths_per_expansion", got.PathsPerExpansion, max.PathsPerExpansion},
618: 		{"behavioral_concerns_per_shard", got.BehavioralConcernsPerShard, max.BehavioralConcernsPerShard}, {"theories_per_shard", got.TheoriesPerShard, max.TheoriesPerShard},
619: 		{"iterations_per_attempt", got.IterationsPerAttempt, max.IterationsPerAttempt}, {"commands_per_attempt", got.CommandsPerAttempt, max.CommandsPerAttempt},
620: 		{"output_repair_attempts", got.OutputRepairAttempts, max.OutputRepairAttempts}, {"concurrent_investigators", got.ConcurrentInvestigators, max.ConcurrentInvestigators},
621: 		{"command_output_bytes", got.CommandOutputBytes, max.CommandOutputBytes}, {"shard_output_bytes", got.ShardOutputBytes, max.ShardOutputBytes},
622: 		{"prompt_bytes", got.PromptBytes, max.PromptBytes}, {"recent_progress", got.RecentProgress, max.RecentProgress},
623: 		{"retained_attempts", got.RetainedAttempts, max.RetainedAttempts}, {"state_bytes", got.StateBytes, max.StateBytes},
624: 		{"tree_files", got.TreeFiles, max.TreeFiles}, {"generated_checks", got.GeneratedChecks, max.GeneratedChecks},
625: 		{"generated_patch_bytes", got.GeneratedPatchBytes, max.GeneratedPatchBytes}, {"evidence_records", got.EvidenceRecords, max.EvidenceRecords},
626: 		{"issues", got.Issues, max.Issues}, {"analyzer_calls", got.AnalyzerCalls, max.AnalyzerCalls}, {"evaluator_calls", got.EvaluatorCalls, max.EvaluatorCalls},
627: 	}
628: 	for _, limit := range ints {
629: 		if limit.got <= 0 || limit.got > limit.max {
630: 			return fmt.Errorf("qa budget %s must be between 1 and %d", limit.name, limit.max)
631: 		}
632: 	}
633: 	durations := []struct {
634: 		name     string
635: 		got, max time.Duration
636: 	}{{"command_timeout", got.CommandTimeout, max.CommandTimeout}, {"shard_timeout", got.ShardTimeout, max.ShardTimeout}, {"run_timeout", got.RunTimeout, max.RunTimeout}, {"cleanup_timeout", got.CleanupTimeout, max.CleanupTimeout}}
637: 	for _, limit := range durations {
638: 		if limit.got <= 0 || limit.got > limit.max {
639: 			return fmt.Errorf("qa budget %s must be positive and no greater than %s", limit.name, limit.max)
640: 		}
641: 	}
642: 	for _, limit := range []struct {
643: 		name     string
644: 		got, max int64
645: 	}{{"tree_bytes", got.TreeBytes, max.TreeBytes}, {"file_bytes", got.FileBytes, max.FileBytes}} {
646: 		if limit.got <= 0 || limit.got > limit.max {
647: 			return fmt.Errorf("qa budget %s must be between 1 and %d", limit.name, limit.max)
648: 		}
649: 	}
650: 	if got.AnalyzerCalls != 3 || got.EvaluatorCalls != 3 {
651: 		return fmt.Errorf("qa semantic analyzer and evaluator counts must be exactly 3")
652: 	}
653: 	return nil
654: }

656: func ValidateQATheory(theory QATheory) error {

660: 	required := map[string]string{"claim": theory.Claim, "basis": theory.Basis, "verification_surface": theory.VerificationSurface, "severity_if_confirmed": theory.SeverityIfConfirmed, "confirmation_condition": theory.ConfirmationCondition, "refutation_condition": theory.RefutationCondition, "inconclusive_condition": theory.InconclusiveCondition, "safe_evidence_strategy": theory.SafeEvidenceStrategy, "outcome_reason": theory.OutcomeReason}
661: 	for name, value := range required {
662: 		if strings.TrimSpace(value) == "" {
663: 			return fmt.Errorf("QA theory %s is required", name)
664: 		}
665: 	}
666: 	if len(theory.ExpectationRefs) == 0 || len(theory.AttemptHistory) == 0 {
667: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA theory expectation references and attempt history are required")
668: 	}
669: 	if !validFingerprint(theory.ImplementationFingerprint) {
670: 		return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA theory implementation fingerprint")
671: 	}
672: 	if !containsQATheoryOutcome(theory.Outcome) {
673: 		return fmt.Errorf("unsupported QA theory outcome %q", theory.Outcome)

678: func ValidateQAMap(m QAMap) error {
679: 	if m.SchemaVersion != QASchemaVersion || !validQAID(m.ID) || !validQAID(m.SemanticAttemptID) || !safeQAName(m.Project) || !safeQAName(m.Sprint) {
680: 		return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA map schema or identity")
681: 	}
682: 	for name, value := range map[string]string{"governed input": m.GovernedInputFingerprint, "implementation": m.ImplementationFingerprint, "review": m.ReviewFingerprint, "policy": m.PolicyFingerprint, "check catalog": m.CheckCatalogFingerprint, "target": m.Target.Fingerprint} {
683: 		if !validFingerprint(value) {
684: 			return fmt.Errorf("invalid %s fingerprint", name)
685: 		}
686: 	}
687: 	if err := validateQABudgets(m.Budgets); err != nil {
688: 		return err
689: 	}
690: 	owners := map[string]int{}
691: 	ownerIDs := map[string]string{}
692: 	for _, shard := range m.Shards {
693: 		if err := ValidateQAShard(shard); err != nil {
694: 			return err
695: 		}
696: 		if shard.Kind == QAShardPrimary {
697: 			for _, path := range shard.ChangedPaths {
698: 				owners[path]++
699: 				ownerIDs[path] = shard.ID
700: 			}
701: 		}
702: 	}
703: 	for _, path := range m.Coverage.ChangedPaths {
704: 		if owners[path] != 1 || m.Coverage.PrimaryOwners[path] != ownerIDs[path] {
705: 			return fmt.Errorf("changed path %q must have exactly one primary owner", path)
706: 		}
707: 	}
708: 	return nil
709: }

711: func ValidateQAShard(shard QAShard) error {
712: 	if shard.SchemaVersion != QASchemaVersion || !validQAID(shard.ID) || !validQAID(shard.AttemptID) || strings.TrimSpace(shard.Title) == "" {
713: 		return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA shard schema or identity")
714: 	}
715: 	switch shard.Kind {
716: 	case QAShardPrimary:
717: 		if len(shard.ChangedPaths) == 0 {
718: 			return fmt.Errorf("primary QA shard requires changed paths")
719: 		}
720: 	case QAShardBoundary:
721: 		if len(shard.OverlapPaths) == 0 || strings.TrimSpace(shard.BoundaryReason) == "" {
722: 			return fmt.Errorf("boundary QA shard requires overlap paths and reason")
723: 		}
724: 	case QAShardFollowUp:
725: 		if len(shard.ParentTheoryIDs) == 0 {
726: 			return fmt.Errorf("follow-up QA shard requires parent theories")
727: 		}
728: 	default:
729: 		return fmt.Errorf("unsupported QA shard kind %q", shard.Kind)
730: 	}
731: 	if !containsQAPhase(shard.Phase) || len(shard.BehavioralConcerns) == 0 || len(shard.ExpectationRefs) == 0 {
732: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA shard phase, concerns, and expectations are required")
733: 	}
734: 	return nil

737: func ValidateQAState(state QAState) error {

739: 		return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA state schema, scope, or phase")
740: 	}
741: 	if state.CurrentAttemptID != "" && !validQAID(state.CurrentAttemptID) {
742: 		return fmt.Errorf("invalid current QA attempt ID")
743: 	}
744: 	if state.CompletedShards < 0 || state.TotalShards < 0 || state.CompletedShards > state.TotalShards {
745: 		return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA shard counts")
746: 	}
747: 	if state.EvidenceCount < 0 || state.RejectedCount < 0 || state.IssueCount < 0 || state.RegressionCandidates < 0 {
748: 		return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA evidence counts")
749: 	}
750: 	if strings.TrimSpace(state.NextAction) == "" || state.UpdatedAt.IsZero() {
751: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA next action and update time are required")
752: 	}
753: 	return nil

756: func ValidateQASynthesis(synthesis QASynthesis, budgets QABudgets) error {
757: 	if synthesis.SchemaVersion != QASchemaVersion || !validQAID(synthesis.ID) || !validQAID(synthesis.AttemptID) || !validQAID(synthesis.MapID) {
758: 		return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA synthesis schema or identity")
759: 	}
760: 	theoryIDs := make(map[string]struct{}, len(synthesis.TheoryIDs))
761: 	for _, theoryID := range synthesis.TheoryIDs {
762: 		if !validQAID(theoryID) {
763: 			return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA synthesis theory reference")
764: 		}
765: 		theoryIDs[theoryID] = struct{}{}
766: 	}
767: 	if len(synthesis.FollowUpShards) > budgets.FollowUpShards {
768: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA synthesis exceeds follow-up shard budget")
769: 	}
770: 	if len(synthesis.Challenges) > budgets.FollowUpShards {
771: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA synthesis exceeds challenger record budget")
772: 	}
773: 	for _, challenge := range synthesis.Challenges {
774: 		if err := ValidateQAChallenge(challenge, budgets); err != nil || challenge.MapID != synthesis.MapID {
775: 			return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA synthesis challenge")
776: 		}
777: 		for _, theoryID := range challenge.TheoryIDs {
778: 			if _, ok := theoryIDs[theoryID]; !ok {
779: 				return fmt.Errorf("QA synthesis challenge references an unknown theory")
780: 			}
781: 		}
782: 	}
783: 	for _, shard := range synthesis.FollowUpShards {
784: 		if err := ValidateQAShard(shard); err != nil || shard.Kind != QAShardFollowUp {
785: 			return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA synthesis follow-up shard")
786: 		}
787: 	}
788: 	if strings.TrimSpace(synthesis.NextAction) == "" {
789: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA synthesis next action is required")
790: 	}
791: 	return nil
792: }

794: func ValidateQAChallenge(challenge QAChallenge, budgets QABudgets) error {
795: 	if challenge.SchemaVersion != QASchemaVersion || !validQAID(challenge.ID) || !validQAID(challenge.MapID) {
796: 		return fmt.Errorf("invalid QA challenge schema or identity")
797: 	}
798: 	if len(challenge.TheoryIDs) == 0 || len(challenge.TheoryIDs) > budgets.TheoriesPerShard {
799: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA challenge theory references exceed bounds")
800: 	}
801: 	for _, theoryID := range challenge.TheoryIDs {

830: func normalizeQAStrings(values []string) []string {
831: 	out := make([]string, 0, len(values))
832: 	seen := map[string]struct{}{}

836: 			continue
837: 		}
838: 		if _, ok := seen[value]; ok {

57: 	sort.Slice(theories, func(i, j int) bool { return theories[i].ID < theories[j].ID })
58: 	theorySet := make(map[string]struct{}, len(theories))
59: 	for _, theory := range theories {
60: 		theorySet[theory.ID] = struct{}{}
61: 	}
62: 	challenges = append([]QAChallenge(nil), challenges...)
63: 	if len(challenges) > qaMap.Budgets.FollowUpShards {
64: 		return QASynthesis{}, NewQAError(QAErrorBudgetExhausted, "synthesize", "challenger record budget is exhausted", nil)
65: 	}
66: 	for i := range challenges {
67: 		challenges[i].TheoryIDs = normalizeQAStrings(challenges[i].TheoryIDs)
68: 		challenges[i].EvidenceRefs = normalizeQAStrings(challenges[i].EvidenceRefs)
69: 		if err := ValidateQAChallenge(challenges[i], qaMap.Budgets); err != nil || challenges[i].MapID != qaMap.ID {
70: 			return QASynthesis{}, NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "synthesize", "challenger record is invalid or stale", err)
71: 		}
72: 		for _, theoryID := range challenges[i].TheoryIDs {
73: 			if _, ok := theorySet[theoryID]; !ok {
74: 				return QASynthesis{}, NewQAError(QAErrorStaleInput, "synthesize", "challenger record references a theory outside the current map", nil)
75: 			}
76: 		}
77: 	}
78: 	sort.Slice(challenges, func(i, j int) bool { return challenges[i].ID < challenges[j].ID })
79: 	theoryIDs := make([]string, 0, len(theories))
80: 	outcomeCounts := map[QATheoryOutcome]int{}
81: 	groups := map[string][]QATheory{}
82: 	for _, theory := range theories {
83: 		theoryIDs = append(theoryIDs, theory.ID)
84: 		outcomeCounts[theory.Outcome]++
85: 		groups[qaTheoryEquivalenceKey(theory)] = append(groups[qaTheoryEquivalenceKey(theory)], theory)
86: 	}
87: 	deduplicated := map[string][]string{}
88: 	var contradictions [][]string
89: 	var followCandidates []QATheory
90: 	keys := make([]string, 0, len(groups))
91: 	for key := range groups {
92: 		keys = append(keys, key)
93: 	}
94: 	sort.Strings(keys)
95: 	for _, key := range keys {
96: 		group := groups[key]
97: 		ids := make([]string, 0, len(group))
98: 		confirmed, refuted := false, false
99: 		for _, theory := range group {
100: 			ids = append(ids, theory.ID)
101: 			confirmed = confirmed || theory.Outcome == QATheoryConfirmed
102: 			refuted = refuted || theory.Outcome == QATheoryRefuted
103: 			if theory.Outcome == QATheoryCrossShard || theory.Outcome == QATheoryInconclusive {
104: 				followCandidates = append(followCandidates, theory)
105: 			}
106: 		}
107: 		sort.Strings(ids)
108: 		if len(ids) > 1 {
109: 			deduplicated[ids[0]] = append([]string(nil), ids[1:]...)
110: 		}
111: 		if confirmed && refuted {
112: 			contradictions = append(contradictions, ids)
113: 		}
114: 	}
115: 	sort.Slice(contradictions, func(i, j int) bool {
116: 		return strings.Join(contradictions[i], "\x00") < strings.Join(contradictions[j], "\x00")
117: 	})
118: 	interactions := qaSynthesisInteractions(theories, shardByTheory)
119: 	sort.Slice(followCandidates, func(i, j int) bool { return followCandidates[i].ID < followCandidates[j].ID })
120: 	if len(followCandidates) > qaMap.Budgets.FollowUpShards {
121: 		followCandidates = followCandidates[:qaMap.Budgets.FollowUpShards]
122: 	}
123: 	followUps := make([]QAShard, 0, len(followCandidates))
124: 	for _, theory := range followCandidates {
125: 		parent := shardByTheory[theory.ID]
126: 		context := normalizeQAStrings(append(append([]string(nil), parent.ChangedPaths...), parent.ContextPaths...))
127: 		if len(context) > qaMap.Budgets.ContextPathsPerShard {
128: 			context = context[:qaMap.Budgets.ContextPathsPerShard]
129: 		}
130: 		identity := QAShardIdentity{Kind: QAShardFollowUp, ContextPaths: context, BehavioralConcerns: []string{"follow up: " + theory.Claim}, ExpectationRefs: normalizeQAStrings(theory.ExpectationRefs), ParentTheoryIDs: []string{theory.ID}}
131: 		id, err := NewQAShardID(qaMap.Project, qaMap.Sprint, qaMap.ID, identity)
132: 		if err != nil {
133: 			return QASynthesis{}, err
134: 		}
135: 		followUps = append(followUps, QAShard{SchemaVersion: 1, ID: id, AttemptID: qaMap.SemanticAttemptID, Kind: QAShardFollowUp, Title: "Follow up " + theory.ID, ContextPaths: context, BehavioralConcerns: identity.BehavioralConcerns, ExpectationRefs: identity.ExpectationRefs, ParentTheoryIDs: identity.ParentTheoryIDs, Phase: QAPhaseMapped})
136: 	}
137: 	sort.Slice(followUps, func(i, j int) bool { return followUps[i].ID < followUps[j].ID })
138: 	followIDs := make([]string, 0, len(followUps))
139: 	for _, shard := range followUps {
140: 		followIDs = append(followIDs, shard.ID)
141: 	}
142: 	challengeIDs := make([]string, 0, len(challenges))
143: 	for _, challenge := range challenges {
144: 		challengeIDs = append(challengeIDs, challenge.ID)
145: 	}
146: 	synthesisID, err := NewQASynthesisID(qaMap.Project, qaMap.Sprint, qaMap.SemanticAttemptID, QASynthesisIdentity{MapID: qaMap.ID, TheoryIDs: theoryIDs, ChallengeIDs: challengeIDs, FollowUpIDs: followIDs, PolicyFingerprint: qaMap.PolicyFingerprint})
147: 	if err != nil {
148: 		return QASynthesis{}, err
149: 	}
150: 	next := "Inspect the retained theory outcomes."
151: 	if len(followUps) > 0 {
152: 		next = "Run the bounded parent-linked follow-up shards."
153: 	} else if len(blockers) > 0 {
154: 		next = "Inspect the retained shard blockers and resume only after their stated prerequisites are restored."
155: 	}
156: 	sort.Slice(blockers, func(i, j int) bool {
157: 		return strings.Join([]string{string(blockers[i].Category), blockers[i].Scope, blockers[i].Summary}, "\x00") < strings.Join([]string{string(blockers[j].Category), blockers[j].Scope, blockers[j].Summary}, "\x00")
158: 	})
159: 	result := QASynthesis{SchemaVersion: 1, ID: synthesisID, AttemptID: qaMap.SemanticAttemptID, MapID: qaMap.ID, TheoryIDs: theoryIDs, Challenges: challenges, Deduplicated: deduplicated, Contradictions: contradictions, Interactions: interactions, FollowUpShards: followUps, OutcomeCounts: outcomeCounts, Blockers: blockers, NextAction: next}
160: 	if len(result.Deduplicated) == 0 {
161: 		result.Deduplicated = nil
162: 	}
163: 	if err := ValidateQASynthesis(result, qaMap.Budgets); err != nil {
164: 		return QASynthesis{}, NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "synthesize", err.Error(), err)
165: 	}
166: 	return result, nil

170: 	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(value, "", "  ")
171: 	if err != nil {
172: 		return nil, err
173: 	}
174: 	return append(data, '\n'), nil
175: }

177: func qaTheoryEquivalenceKey(theory QATheory) string {
178: 	refs := normalizeQAStrings(theory.ExpectationRefs)
179: 	return strings.ToLower(strings.Join([]string{strings.TrimSpace(theory.Claim), strings.TrimSpace(theory.VerificationSurface), strings.Join(refs, "\x00")}, "\x00"))

182: func qaSynthesisInteractions(theories []QATheory, owners map[string]QAShard) []string {
183: 	var interactions []string
184: 	for i := 0; i < len(theories); i++ {
185: 		for j := i + 1; j < len(theories); j++ {
186: 			left, right := owners[theories[i].ID], owners[theories[j].ID]
187: 			if left.ID == right.ID {

189: 			}
190: 			if theories[i].Outcome == QATheoryCrossShard || theories[j].Outcome == QATheoryCrossShard || shareQAString(left.RiskTags, right.RiskTags) {
191: 				interactions = append(interactions, fmt.Sprintf("%s <-> %s", theories[i].ID, theories[j].ID))
192: 			}
193: 		}
194: 	}
195: 	return normalizeQAStrings(interactions)
196: }

199: 	set := map[string]struct{}{}
200: 	for _, value := range left {
201: 		set[value] = struct{}{}
202: 	}
203: 	for _, value := range right {
204: 		if _, ok := set[value]; ok {
205: 			return true
206: 		}
207: 	}
208: 	return false

That's a major new behavior: QA start now runs isolated evidence checks that COPY THE ENTIRE TARGET TREE and run commands in a writable copy. This is a significant trust transition from "read-only QA" to "writable isolated evidence". Key areas to scrutinize: 1. **buildQAEvidencePublication** (qa.go:442-552): - `descriptor := QACheckDescriptor{Executable: "true", ...}` fallback when no go descriptors. Then `exec.LookPath(descriptor.Executable)` → looks up "true" in PATH. Args empty. This executes `/usr/bin/true` inside the isolated workspace copy via RunQAInvestigation with `req.Plan.Args` = []. - Wait — plan executable is resolved to an absolute path via LookPath before freezing. That's fine. - `RunQAInvestigation` copies the whole target tree (CreateIsolation) per shard! With up to 44 shards... but WritableConcurrency=1? Actually buildQAEvidencePublication loops shards sequentially. OK. - The check for target root leaking into child args: `strings.Contains(strings.Join(append(append([]string(nil), req.Plan.Args...), valuesOnly(req.Environment)...), "\x00"), req.TargetRoot)`. 2. **evaluateFailedEvidence**: 3 evaluator LLM calls; each uses `json.Unmarshal` on result.TerminalOutput without strict decoding (no DisallowUnknownFields, trailing data allowed by Unmarshal? Actually json.Unmarshal rejects trailing garbage except whitespace). It requires SchemaVersion == QAEvidenceSchemaVersion (2). OK. 3. **AdjudicateFailedShard**: majority vote pass/fail. 4. **Publish evidence path**: `publishEvidence` writes patches, plans, records, adjudication, issues, assessment, report (`qa.md` at sprint root!). Note QAReportRelPath is `projects/

/sprints//qa.md` — outside `verification/`! The chmod walk in privateAtomicWrite only applies if pathHasComponent(path, "verification"). For qa.md, dir = sprint dir; MkdirAll(dir, 0700)... then no chmod walk. But note: privateAtomicWrite creates temp file in dir and renames. qa.md at sprint level — this replaces whatever was there. Hmm wait, was there a pre-existing qa.md convention? Let me check what else writes qa.md. 5. **The rollback logic in Publish**: captureQACanonicalFiles(statePath, reportPath, flowPath) reads all three files into memory BEFORE writing. canonicalStarted only set after evidence publish begins... Actually look: ```go canonicalStarted := false defer func() { if resultErr != nil && canonicalStarted { restore } }() ``` canonicalStarted is set true at line 555 right before state write, and also set true at line 547 `canonicalStarted = len(publication.Evidence.Report) > 0` before publishEvidence. If evidence publication fails partway (after writing some plans/records but before report), canonicalStarted may be false → NO rollback of partially-written evidence files (plans/evidence are immutable writeRecord(true)). Actually those are immutable so re-running would conflict... hmm, but same bytes → fine. Different bytes → Conflict. Since plans/records IDs are content-derived, rerun produces identical bytes. But wait — there's a subtle issue: if `publication.Evidence != nil` and Report is non-empty, canonicalStarted = true before publishEvidence; then if publishEvidence fails midway, rollback restores state.json/report/flow to prior bytes — good. But it does NOT remove the newly written plans/evidence/adjudication/issues/assessment files. Those are immutable records keyed by content-derived IDs; they'd be orphaned but consistent. Not a security issue. 6. **State schema version switching**: Publish sets `publication.State.SchemaVersion = QAStateSchemaVersion` (2) when Evidence != nil. 34: // durableCLICommand is the synchronous CLI counterpart to the web/TUI

93: func newDurableOperationManager(repository runcontrol.Repository, owner runcontrol.Owner) *durableOperationManager {

95: }

97: func (m *durableOperationManager) AcceptOperation(ctx context.Context, confirmation Confirmation, digest string) (AcceptedOperation, error) {
98: 	req := confirmation.Request
99: 	target := runcontrol.Target{
100: 		Kind: "operation", Operation: string(req.Kind), Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint,
101: 		Study: req.Study, Stage: req.Stage, Task: req.Task,
102: 	}
103: 	snapshot, err := m.repository.Accept(ctx, runcontrol.Acceptance{
104: 		Target: target, ProductStatus: "prepared", OperationAlias: digest, ConfirmationDigest: digest,
105: 	})
106: 	if err != nil && digest != "" && errors.Is(err, runcontrol.ErrConflict) {
107: 		existing, resolveErr := m.repository.ResolveOperationAlias(ctx, digest)
108: 		if resolveErr != nil {
109: 			return AcceptedOperation{}, errors.Join(err, resolveErr)
110: 		}
111: 		return AcceptedOperation{RunID: string(existing.RunID), Context: ctx, Existing: true, Lifecycle: string(existing.Lifecycle)}, nil
112: 	}
113: 	if err != nil {
114: 		return AcceptedOperation{}, fmt.Errorf("persist confirmed operation acceptance: %w", err)
115: 	}
116: 	attempt, _, err := m.repository.Claim(ctx, runcontrol.Claim{RunID: snapshot.RunID, Owner: m.owner, Lease: runcontrol.OwnerLeaseDuration})
117: 	if err != nil {
118: 		return AcceptedOperation{}, fmt.Errorf("persist confirmed operation owner claim: %w", err)
119: 	}
120: 	fence := runcontrol.Fence{RunID: snapshot.RunID, AttemptID: attempt.ID, OwnerID: m.owner.ID, FencingGeneration: attempt.FencingGeneration}
121: 	if _, _, err := appendRunEventWithRetry(ctx, m.repository, fence, runcontrol.EventDraft{
122: 		Type: runcontrol.EventLifecycle, Lifecycle: runcontrol.LifecycleRunning,
123: 		Payload: map[string]string{"lifecycle": string(runcontrol.LifecycleRunning)},
124: 	}); err != nil {
125: 		terminalCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
126: 		_, _, _ = proposeRunTerminalWithRetry(terminalCtx, m.repository, fence, runcontrol.TerminalProposal{Outcome: runcontrol.TerminalPersistenceLost, Reason: "operation start persistence failed", ProposedBy: m.owner.ID})
127: 		cancel()
128: 		return AcceptedOperation{}, fmt.Errorf("persist confirmed operation start: %w", err)
129: 	}
130: 	operationCtx, cancel := context.WithCancel(runcontrol.WithParentRun(ctx, snapshot.RunID))
131: 	operationCtx = context.WithValue(operationCtx, durableOperationContextKey{}, durableOperationOwnership{repository: m.repository, fence: fence})
132: 	owned := &ownedDurableOperation{fence: fence, cancel: cancel, stop: make(chan struct{}), done: make(chan struct{})}
133: 	m.mu.Lock()
134: 	m.owned[string(snapshot.RunID)] = owned
135: 	m.mu.Unlock()
136: 	go m.controlOperation(operationCtx, owned)
137: 	return AcceptedOperation{RunID: string(snapshot.RunID), Context: operationCtx, Lifecycle: string(runcontrol.LifecycleRunning)}, nil
138: }

140: func qaOwnershipFromContext(ctx context.Context) (sprint.QAWriterToken, func(sprint.QAWriterToken) error, error) {
141: 	ownership, ok := ctx.Value(durableOperationContextKey{}).(durableOperationOwnership)
142: 	if !ok || ownership.repository == nil {
143: 		return sprint.QAWriterToken{}, nil, errors.New("durable QA ownership is missing from the operation context")
144: 	}

146: 	fence := func(got sprint.QAWriterToken) error {
147: 		if got != token {
148: 			return runcontrol.ErrStaleFence
149: 		}
150: 		fenceCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.WithoutCancel(ctx), 30*time.Second)
151: 		defer cancel()
152: 		_, err := ownership.repository.Heartbeat(fenceCtx, ownership.fence, runControlLease)
153: 		return err
154: 	}
155: 	return token, fence, nil

158: func (m *durableOperationManager) RecordOperationEvent(ctx context.Context, runID string, event OperationEvent) (bool, error) {
159: 	m.mu.Lock()
160: 	owned := m.owned[runID]
161: 	m.mu.Unlock()
162: 	if owned == nil {
163: 		return false, runcontrol.ErrNotFound
164: 	}
165: 	owned.eventMu.Lock()
166: 	defer owned.eventMu.Unlock()
167: 	eventType := runcontrol.EventProgress
168: 	if event.State == OperationFailed {
169: 		eventType = runcontrol.EventWarning
170: 	}
171: 	key := string(eventType) + "\x00" + event.Stage + "\x00" + event.Task + "\x00" + event.PhaseState + "\x00" + event.SafeSummary + "\x00" + event.EventType + "\x00" + event.EventKind + "\x00" + event.Tool + "\x00" + event.Reason + "\x00" + event.Detail

173: 	elapsed := now.Sub(owned.progressAt)
174: 	if eventType == runcontrol.EventProgress && key == owned.progressKey && elapsed >= 0 && elapsed < runcontrol.ProgressCoalesceWindow {
175: 		if owned.omitted == 0 {
176: 			owned.omittedFirst = now
177: 		}
178: 		owned.omitted++
179: 		owned.omittedLast = now
180: 		return false, nil
181: 	}
182: 	payload := map[string]string{
183: 		"state": string(event.State), "type": event.EventType,
184: 		"count": fmt.Sprintf("%d/%d", event.Completed, event.Total),
185: 	}
186: 	for key, value := range map[string]string{
187: 		"phase_state": event.PhaseState, "summary": event.SafeSummary,
188: 		"tool_call_id": event.ToolCallID, "tool_status": event.ToolStatus,
189: 		"tool_arguments": event.ToolArguments, "tool_result": event.ToolResult, "tool_error": event.ToolError,
190: 		"provider": event.Provider, "model": event.Model, "harness": event.Harness,
191: 	} {
192: 		if value != "" {
193: 			payload[key] = value
194: 		}
195: 	}
196: 	var omission *runcontrol.Omission
197: 	if event.Message != "" {
198: 		omission = &runcontrol.Omission{Reason: "presentation message omitted", Count: 1}
199: 	}
200: 	if owned.omitted > 0 {
201: 		if omission == nil {
202: 			omission = &runcontrol.Omission{Reason: "equivalent progress coalesced"}
203: 		}
204: 		omission.Count += owned.omitted
205: 		omission.FirstAt, omission.LastAt = &owned.omittedFirst, &owned.omittedLast
206: 		owned.omitted = 0
207: 	}
208: 	_, _, err := appendRunEventWithRetry(ctx, m.repository, owned.fence, runcontrol.EventDraft{
209: 		Type: eventType, Scope: runcontrol.EventScopeOperation, Stage: event.Stage, Task: event.Task,
210: 		Kind: event.EventKind, Tool: event.Tool, Action: event.Action, Reason: event.Reason,
211: 		Detail: event.Detail, Payload: payload, Omission: omission,
212: 	})
213: 	if err != nil {
214: 		owned.cancel()
215: 		return false, err
216: 	}
217: 	if eventType == runcontrol.EventProgress {
218: 		owned.progressKey, owned.progressAt = key, now
219: 	}
220: 	return true, nil
221: }

223: func (m *durableOperationManager) controlOperation(ctx context.Context, owned *ownedDurableOperation) {
224: 	defer close(owned.done)
225: 	ticker := time.NewTicker(runcontrol.OwnerTickInterval)
226: 	defer ticker.Stop()
227: 	lastHeartbeat, lastReconcile := time.Now(), time.Now()
228: 	for {
229: 		select {
230: 		case <-ctx.Done():
231: 			return
232: 		case <-owned.stop:
233: 			return
234: 		case now := <-ticker.C:
235: 			snapshot, err := m.repository.Snapshot(ctx, owned.fence.RunID)
236: 			if err != nil {
237: 				owned.cancel()
238: 				return
239: 			}
240: 			if snapshot.Cancellation.State == runcontrol.CancellationRequested {
241: 				if _, _, err := m.repository.AcknowledgeCancellation(ctx, owned.fence); err != nil {
242: 					owned.cancel()
243: 					return
244: 				}
245: 				owned.cancel()
246: 				return
247: 			}
248: 			if now.Sub(lastHeartbeat) >= runcontrol.HeartbeatInterval {
249: 				if _, err := m.repository.Heartbeat(ctx, owned.fence, runcontrol.OwnerLeaseDuration); err != nil {
250: 					owned.cancel()
251: 					return
252: 				}
253: 				lastHeartbeat = now
254: 			}
255: 			if now.Sub(lastReconcile) >= runcontrol.ReconciliationInterval {
256: 				if _, err := m.repository.Reconcile(ctx, runcontrol.NativeProcessProbe{}, runcontrol.ReconcileOptions{}); err != nil {
257: 					owned.cancel()
258: 					return
259: 				}
260: 				lastReconcile = now
261: 			}
262: 		}
263: 	}
264: }
265: 
266: func (m *durableOperationManager) FinishOperation(ctx context.Context, runID string, state OperationState, runErr error) error {
267: 	m.mu.Lock()
268: 	owned := m.owned[runID]
269: 	delete(m.owned, runID)
270: 	m.mu.Unlock()
271: 	if owned == nil {
272: 		return nil
273: 	}
274: 	owned.eventMu.Lock()
275: 	if owned.omitted > 0 {
276: 		_, _, appendErr := appendRunEventWithRetry(ctx, m.repository, owned.fence, runcontrol.EventDraft{Type: runcontrol.EventOmission, Omission: &runcontrol.Omission{Reason: "equivalent progress coalesced", Count: owned.omitted, FirstAt: &owned.omittedFirst, LastAt: &owned.omittedLast}})
277: 		if appendErr != nil && runErr == nil {
278: 			runErr = appendErr
279: 		}
280: 		owned.omitted = 0
281: 	}
282: 	owned.eventMu.Unlock()
283: 	close(owned.stop)
284: 	<-owned.done
285: 	owned.cancel()
286: 	outcome := runcontrol.TerminalSucceeded
287: 	reason := "operation completed"
288: 	switch {
289: 	case errors.Is(runErr, context.DeadlineExceeded):
290: 		outcome, reason = runcontrol.TerminalTimedOut, "operation deadline exceeded"
291: 	case errors.Is(runErr, context.Canceled), state == OperationCancelled:
292: 		outcome, reason = runcontrol.TerminalCancelled, "operation cancelled"
293: 	case runErr != nil, state == OperationFailed:
294: 		outcome, reason = runcontrol.TerminalFailed, "operation failed"
295: 	case state == OperationPartial:
296: 		outcome, reason = runcontrol.TerminalInterrupted, "operation interrupted"
297: 	}
298: 	_, _, err := proposeRunTerminalWithRetry(ctx, m.repository, owned.fence, runcontrol.TerminalProposal{Outcome: outcome, Reason: reason, ProposedBy: m.owner.ID})
299: 	return err

14: type durableOperationManager struct {
15: 	repository runcontrol.Repository
16: 	owner      runcontrol.Owner
17: 	mu         sync.Mutex
18: 	owned      map[string]*ownedDurableOperation
19: }
20: 
21: type ownedDurableOperation struct {
22: 	fence        runcontrol.Fence
23: 	cancel       context.CancelFunc
24: 	stop         chan struct{}
25: 	done         chan struct{}
26: 	eventMu      sync.Mutex
27: 	progressKey  string
28: 	progressAt   time.Time
29: 	omitted      uint64
30: 	omittedFirst time.Time
31: 	omittedLast  time.Time
32: }

34: // durableCLICommand is the synchronous CLI counterpart to the web/TUI
35: // acceptance boundary. It keeps the manager alive for the whole command and
36: // gives product code the cancellation-aware context owned by the durable run.
37: type durableCLICommand struct {
38: 	manager  *durableOperationManager
39: 	accepted AcceptedOperation
40: }
41: 
42: type durableOperationContextKey struct{}

44: type durableOperationOwnership struct {
45: 	repository runcontrol.Repository
46: 	fence      runcontrol.Fence
47: }

49: func beginDurableCLICommand(deps dependencies, request OperationRequest) (*durableCLICommand, error) {
50: 	repository, _, err := runRepository(deps)
51: 	if err != nil {
52: 		return nil, err
53: 	}
54: 	manager := newDurableOperationManager(repository, deps.runControl.owner)
55: 	accepted, err := manager.AcceptOperation(deps.ctx, Confirmation{Request: request}, "")
56: 	if err != nil {
57: 		return nil, classifiedCause(ExitRuntime, err, "run-control.accept")
58: 	}
59: 	return &durableCLICommand{manager: manager, accepted: accepted}, nil
60: }
61: 
62: func (c *durableCLICommand) Context() context.Context { return c.accepted.Context }
63: 
64: func (c *durableCLICommand) QAWriterToken() (sprint.QAWriterToken, func(sprint.QAWriterToken) error, error) {
65: 	if c == nil {
66: 		return sprint.QAWriterToken{}, nil, errors.New("durable QA ownership is unavailable")
67: 	}
68: 	return qaOwnershipFromContext(c.accepted.Context)
69: }

71: func (c *durableCLICommand) Finish(runErr error) error {
72: 	state := OperationComplete
73: 	if c.accepted.Context.Err() != nil {
74: 		state = OperationCancelled
75: 	} else if runErr != nil {
76: 		state = OperationFailed
77: 	}
78: 	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
79: 	defer cancel()
80: 	if err := c.manager.FinishOperation(ctx, c.accepted.RunID, state, runErr); err != nil {
81: 		return classifiedCause(ExitRuntime, err, "run-control.finish")
82: 	}
83: 	return nil
84: }

86: func finishDurableCLICommand(command *durableCLICommand, runErr error) error {
87: 	if command == nil {
88: 		return runErr
89: 	}
90: 	return errors.Join(runErr, command.Finish(runErr))
91: }
